payload.name: Current-work-second-lookup
payload.description: When a question asks what kind of fiction/stories a person writes or creates, and the first memory search returns only reading preferences or older events, run a second targeted search for current or recent writing activities before answering.
content: Before answering what a person writes/creates, verify the evidence includes a current work or recent qualifier.

If the first search returned only preferences or older events, run one additional hybrid search using current-activity terms ('working on', 'writing', 'currently', 'recently', 'challenge') with top_k 5.
Stop after this second search; answer only from combined visible evidence unless it still cannot state genre or an explicitly mentioned feature.

solves: When asked what a person writes/creates, one preference-focused search can miss current specifics such as genre plus a notable feature (e.g., plot twists). Apply when the first pass returns only reading interests or older events: run one extra retrieval for current/recent writing terms, then answer from explicit current memories. Do not apply to simple preference questions where general interests suffice and no current work is implied.
